tasks.prompt: How does Alex feel when the next step is clear?

learner_material:
EMAIL
Dear Amina,

My address has changed. I would like to update my contact details. Please confirm the session on Monday 15 February 2027 at 9:30, in Room 8. I will bring my reference card. Is there anything else I should prepare?

Kind regards,
Alex Morgan

OPTIONS
Option A: a staffed appointment. The user prefers this option because a member of staff can help them check the change.
Option B: an online form. This remains an alternative; ask the service about its availability.

INSTRUCTIONS
1. First, read your confirmation.
2. Then bring your reference card to Room 8.
3. Check your details before leaving.
If you cannot attend on Monday 15 February 2027, contact Amina before Sunday 14 February 2027 at 18:00. Do not wait until after the session.

VOCABULARY IN CONTEXT
The office keeps a record of the contact details.

PRACTICE GLOSSARY (alphabetical)
available — free or ready to be used
record — information kept about a person or event
session — a period of time used for a particular activity
support — help given to someone
